description.value: Established in 1980, Tantalus Lodge is one of Whistler's original hotels, offering spacious suite-style accommodations tucked into a quiet forest setting just a 5-minute walk from Whistler Village. All suites include full kitchens, wood-burning fireplaces, and private balconies, with shared outdoor hot tubs, a heated pool, and a barrel sauna on the property. Touring cyclists will find it a self-contained base with kitchen facilities for preparing their own food and easy access to the full range of village amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms this is an actively operating hotel in Whistler with current booking functionality and 2025 cancellation policy dates. The website explicitly confirms WiFi ('Complimentary wifi is available both in your suite and throughout the Tantalus Lodge'), luggage storage ('For hotel guests, luggage storage is available at no additional fee'), and nearby dining ('5 minute walk from endless dining and shopping options in Whistler Village'). No mention of bike-specific storage, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash appears anywhere in the site content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with active bookings, confirmed contact details, and clear public accessibility. Straightforward include.
